selection.best_description: Triggers when a user asks to create, define, refine, update, delete, or doctor a buyer or stakeholder persona file in a connected GTM workspace, including choosing which organization owns it. Not for ICPs, teammate records, general persona advice, or creating, importing, deleting, or repairing the workspace repository itself.
selection.reason: Candidates 0, 1, and 2 tied at 20/20 overall and 8/8 held-out; candidate 0 wins the non-regression and lowest-context tie-break. Candidate 3 missed the guided-menu and library-repair positives.
